adaptive_acquisition: Freeze the current moment-matched covariance and PIPs for scoring; refit PIPs only after paid observations. KG does not integrate future support changes.
primary_comparison: conditional_hard minus fixed_source on binding shared_structure: final three-head RMSE and penalized regret
secondary_comparisons: conditional_hard versus learned_v1 isolates conditional source selection
conditional_soft versus conditional_hard isolates retaining a weak Gaussian tail
conditional_adaptive versus conditional_soft tests target-refitted support and inference together
selection: Two-fold held-out source prediction; greedy conditional loss decrease must exceed one source-task standard error; maximum four functions per head. Adaptive PIPs encode leave-one-source-task-out selection frequency.
soft_tail: Unselected functions share 10 percent of source signal variance; selected function coefficient means remain zero.
interpretation: Retain all negatives. Prediction gain alone does not establish decision value. Descriptive paired seed intervals are not a submission readiness gate. No retuning these seeds or difficulty offsets after results.
scope: Public canonical eight-dimensional inputs and a fixed 68-function dictionary. Source-learned support and coefficient scales; no learned trajectory encoder, arbitrary high-dimensional guarantee or real application claim. Original v1 protocol/results and September initialization study are retained.
